answer: In commit-reveal, agents submit work receipts in two steps. Each identity must prove possession of a unique crystal nonce. A raven-optimized immutable commit log lets independent auditors track these across an orchard of shards. Every fake ID requires mining a new nonce in real-time, coupling its cost to physical compute. The nonces deplete like non-fungible tickets, with synchronization handoffs through the log. Attackers can't replicate this in parallel—the more heads they deploy, the more serial constraints compress their attack frontier.
